description: This file defines a modulesClient object with functions to fetch dashboard modules and overview metrics from a backend API, including utility functions for URL resolution and JSON fetching.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with error handling and optional credentials.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a dashboard overview, attempting multiple endpoints, or derives minimal data if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total users and deployed apps metrics for the dashboard overview.
